lines.en: I turn and run, through the brush.
My hooves land in a panic.
I shove branches out of the way.
I run low to the ground.
A few strides carry me far.
I plunge deeper into the trees.
I do not dare stop for a step.

lines.zh: 我的角撞掉了几根小枝
lines.en: My antlers knock off a few twigs.
My running line wanders.
I climb the snowy slope at a run.
I squeeze between trunks.
I have not slowed at all.

lines.zh: 我跑过的地方雪都翻了
lines.en: The snow is torn where I passed.
I dive into the thicket.
I hide behind a tree.
One flare and I retreat.
My breathing has not evened out.
I do not dare move a step.
I crouch very low.
I am listening for pursuit.
I dare not look back.
This brush can hide me.
My antlers are still quivering.

lines.zh: 雪落在我背上我都不敢抖
lines.en: Snow settles on my back and I dare not shake it.

lines.zh: 信号弹的光还留在眼里。
lines.en: The flare's light still burns in my eyes.
I try to make no sound.
My legs are still trembling.
I am waiting for the sound to fade.
That little light frightens me.
I step back a pace.
Do not come any further.
I cannot pull my antlers back.
Hold it up and I will run.
I know that kind of light.
You smell of smoke.
I have backed behind a tree.
I will not go with you.
Put that thing away.
Both my legs have gone weak.
What is it you mean to do?
All I can do is run.
The pain makes me run faster.
My whole body shudders.
My hoof slips through.
That only panics me more.
My antlers are knocked crooked.
My chest heaves faster.
I grit my teeth and keep running.
I will remember that one for good.
These legs can still carry me.
I duck behind a tree.
I will not eat; I am afraid.
Take that thing away.
I have no appetite for anything.
Do not come at me holding that.
One sniff and I start shaking.
I do not want it at all.
That scrap of food is not worth staying.
Lay it down and I still will not take it.
I do not dare look at it.
All I want is to run.
That thing smells of smoke.
You are tricking me, are you not?
I am leaving right now.
Do not follow behind me.
I will take none of it.
I wheel round and bolt.
You knocked me off balance.
I nearly fall.
I bolt past you.
Do not stand across my way.
Your foot is on my hoof.
I back away a long way.
I shove past you.
I dare not stop for an instant.
I hit a tree and keep running.
Let me pass first.
I only want to run now.
Do not grab my antlers.
I dare not think of such things.
I want to see no one.
I shake my head and back away.
Let go of me first.
I back deeper into the woods.
I do not want to say anything.
I am not picking anything up.
I run right over it.
I do not look at the ground.
Keep that away from me.
I do not want to take anything now.
I dare not bend down.
I run past it without stopping.
Whose it is, I am not giving it back.
I only want to get away.
You raised that thing.
I am off and running.
I know that sound.
My legs moved on their own.
I have turned around.
I do not care whether you mean to strike.
I am not fighting you.
I am running for the trees.
Do not come chasing me.
I truly cannot hold on.
I keep backing into the trees.
I dare not turn my head.
I head where the trees are thick.
I am too winded to speak.
My antlers catch on a branch.
I stumble again.
My legs are trembling.
I have not stopped once.
I am getting further from you.
I only need to leave this wood.
I crash straight into the thicket.
I did not mean to hurt you.
I kick out at you.
That was pure panic.
I swing my head, antlers raking.
I break into a run again.
Good, you stepped aside.
I nearly trip and fall.
I cannot even tell directions.
I come fleeing out of the woods.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一串乱脚印
lines.en: A scatter of tracks joins the snow.
I have not got my breath back.
Broken twigs hang from my antlers.
If I stop, I start shaking.
Twigs still hang from my antlers.
This is deep enough to hide.
I lean on a trunk, gasping.

lines.zh: 我听见后面没有声音了
lines.en: I hear nothing behind me now.
I crouch down slowly.
My every breath comes out white.
Fire is as terrible as that light.
Muddy water fills my mouth and nose.
An arrow bites my calf.
Magic sets my scalp crawling.
Hunger has taken my legs.
One crack of thunder and I bolt.
The snow under me is suddenly gone.
